subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Sweetheart Swindlers Who Target the Elderly
description: A micro-lesson that makes Sweetheart Swindlers Who Target the Elderly usable.

hook.text: A lonely widow meets a charming man at church. Within months, her life savings are gone.

buildup.text: In-person romance scams target isolated elderly people, offering companionship in exchange for money.

discovery.text: The scammer becomes essential — driving errands, managing finances, isolating the victim from family.

twist.text: Adult Protective Services sees thousands of these cases, but proving coercion is extremely difficult.

climax.text: Financial exploitation of the elderly exceeds $28 billion annually in the United States.

punchline.text: Loneliness is the vulnerability. Companionship is the weapon.

quiz.question: How much is lost annually to elder financial exploitation in the U.S.?
